name: Zombies
overview: Scripture presents vivid imagery of death and resurrection, portraying a future time when the dead will rise, as seen in Isaiah's promise that the earth shall cast out the dead and they shall live again (Isaiah 26:19). Daniel further clarifies that this awakening will result in either everlasting life or shame and contempt (Daniel 12:2). The prophetic warnings in Zechariah and Jeremiah describe the judgment of God’s enemies with graphic depictions of flesh consuming away and desperate acts during siege (Zechariah 14:12; Jeremiah 19:9), underscoring the seriousness of divine judgment. These passages collectively emphasize God's sovereign power over life, death, and resurrection, pointing to the ultimate hope and warning found in the day of the Lord (Isaiah 13:6; Matthew 27:51).
